Friday, May 9, 2025 at 8:37 AM

@everyone

Community Vote: What Should We Do With the Remaining COPIC SPO Rewards?

Background:
The COPIC stake pool was launched with 125% COPI rewards based on ADA staking earnings, capped at 15 million COPI or 1 year, whichever came first. The final eligible epoch under the original terms is Epoch 558 (ends May 19). Roughly 3 million COPI remains unallocated.

We’re asking for your input on how you prefer we use the remaining rewards.

Voting Options:

 End the pool as originally planned
→ Halt rewards after Epoch 558 and retain the remaining ~3M COPI for other staking initiatives down the road.

 Continue the pool until the remaining 3M COPI is fully depleted
→ At the current pace, this would extend rewards for an estimated 10–13 additional epochs under the same 125% reward rate.

@everyone 

 COPIC SPO Update – Community Vote Result & Next Steps

Thanks to everyone who voted!
The community has chosen Option 1 — to end the COPI reward program according to the original terms. Here's what that means:

 Pool Transition Details


Epoch 558 is the final epoch to earn 125% COPI rewards, ending Mon, May 19, 2025, at 9:44:51 PM UTC.
,
The pool margin was changed at the end of Epoch 557 and took effect in Epoch 558.
,
The COPIC stake pool now operates at a 5% margin, matching the COPI pool, until further notice or the loyalty program launch.
,
While the 125% COPI bonus has ended, we're still incentivizing healthy staking in both COPI and COPIC.
,

 Ongoing Bonus
Until the loyalty program is introduced, we're offering a fixed reward of 12,500 COPI per epoch per pool (2,500 COPI per day, per pool).
This is well within our tokenomics limits for staking rewards across all chains.


Rewards are distributed proportionally based on your staked ADA in each pool.
,
There is no multiplier or compounding — each epoch is calculated independently.
,
This mirrors our EVM staking structure, but without a multiplier.
,
You can continue to claim your COPI rewards through Drip Dropz as usual.
,

 What’s Next: Loyalty Program

We're developing a new loyalty program that will reward activity across both Web2 and Web3. While final details are still in progress, it may include:


A

return of COPI bonuses** tied to events or milestones

Thank you for supporting the COPIC pool and being part of the Cornucopias ecosystem! (edited)
